topic: How the Moon runs the tides
title: Why Are There Two Tides a Day? How the Moon Moves the Ocean
description:
The Moon is on one side of the Earth, so why does the sea rise twice a day? A clear walk through tidal bulges, the fifty-minute delay, the Sun's part, spring and neap tides, and the biggest tide on Earth. #Tides #Moon #HowItWorks #Science #Ocean
